profile.name: Rafely Chandra Rizkilillah
profile.subtitle: Meticulous Craftsmanship in Scalable Payment Systems, High-Velocity APIs & Fintech Architecture
retroNarrative: In an era of rapid digital transactions, Rafely operates at the precise intersection of concurrent Go code, high-throughput payment pipelines, and secure ledger telemetry. Fabricating robust digital apparatuses that handle millions of micro-finance data transmissions with absolute mathematical reliability.

With over five years of documented practice in fintech payment workshops, Rafely has mastered the alignment of core financial flows. His digital workbench delivers resilient full-stack elements, safe server-side gateway relays (KrakenD, Kong), and databases engineered with high-fidelity performance.

Whether launching QRIS integration nodes, tuning database query metrics, or structuring secure e-wallet top-ups, he approaches code with rigorous standards corresponding to the classic Swiss grid layouts of early computational systems.

description: Handle the Payment Platform Team, ensuring exceptional reliability and high scalability for all core financial transaction pathways, including disbursement, repayment, cash-in/out, remittance, and Virtual Account management.
Lead the high-priority QRIS integration project with 3 engineers under my direction, expanding the platform's monetary ecosystem with QR-based payments.
Pioneered secure integrations with major third-party payment providers (BRI, Midtrans, Digiasia, Xendit) containing resilient failed-payment retry triggers.
Built automatic e-wallet top-up pathways (GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay, LinkAja), cash-out processing, and secure order loan services.
Managed the main MIS Dashboard, overseeing all loan allocations, investor transactions, and automated installment payment ledger transactions.
Led the integration and software migration of the core banking system with vendor FDS, ensuring seamless data-flow with robust failure safety.
Rebuilt critical core money flow pathways handling automated disbursements, repayment, and partial-repayment calculations.
Redesigned the automated loan insurance claim system for PAR loans with consecutive defaults, minimizing risk profile and protecting investors.
Designed and implemented high-availability CRUD operations using RESTful API structures, PostgreSQL, and custom-tailored middleware solutions.
Developed and maintained rapid API endpoints for the public FAQ database and customer-facing support documentation indexes.
Collaborated with the Customer Service Improvement team to implement logging telemetry, reducing action latency and boosting service efficiency.

achievements: Conducted studies in distributed algorithms, multi-thread mechanics, relational algebra databases, and internet-protocol engineering.
Engineered visual database dashboards and high-performance programming lab tooling.
